- **Open ticket:** an undated North team summary says Thea's ticket #4419 went to tier-2 product support. It's about the Door 14 gate scanners not reading trailer tags on third shift. If today's problem is the same one, she should quote that number.
- **Name mix-up:** Quarendon Freightways is a different company. It isn't a Pemberline customer.

Dana is in every channel and file I used, so nothing she couldn't already see went into the reply. I sent no mail and no approvals were needed.
